+## Review Findings (2026-10-20 20:56)
+
+> Scope: `review sha HEAD~1..HEAD` — reviewed the diffs only — lines this change added or modified. 10 file(s) reviewed, 2 not reviewed.

+- [ ] `Sources/AgentViewKit/Attachments/ArtifactView.swift:63` `reuse/reuse` — The added background and separator overlay in ArtifactView rebuild the surface that `AgentContentSurface` already draws (`.background(.background.secondary, in:)` plus `.overlay(shape.stroke(.separator))`). The only difference is the corner radius. The existing modifier is a near-match that was not extended. Adding a radius parameter to `agentContentSurface()` would give one canonical surface instead of a parallel copy that can drift. Give `AgentContentSurface` and `View.agentContentSurface()` an optional radius parameter, defaulting to the large radius of the theme. Replace the inline `.background` and `.overlay` in ArtifactView.swift:63-66 with `.agentContentSurface(radius: theme.radii.m)`.

The test fixture at line 42 shows this case, and the assertion at line 48 expects only two matches, which locks the gap in place. Kit views that use this shape would not fail the `noKitViewGivesAFixedCornerRadius` guard, so the decision to replace fixed corner radii with `AgentSurface.shape(radius:)` is not enforced for that shape. Add `UnevenRoundedRectangle` to the `ChoiceOf` at lines 19-22 with `WordPattern.wholeWord`, and change the assertion at line 48 to expect `A.swift:5` as well. Then run `noKitViewGivesAFixedCornerRadius` to confirm that no kit view uses `UnevenRoundedRectangle(cornerRadius:)`.
